Azeroth Survivors Save Transfer and Backup Guide

Make a local copy before changing browsers or devices, then use the game’s own export and import controls. This guide never uploads, reads, or stores your save.

SAVE GUIDE

IMPORTANT · READ BEFORE IMPORTING

Importing may replace all progress in the destination save. Export that destination save first if you want to keep it. Keep the original export untouched until you have confirmed the imported progress in the game.

BROWSER STORAGE

Where Is Your Save Stored?

A recent third-party guide reports that the browser game saves automatically in browser site data, while its Windows build uses a Saves folder. Web storage APIs are scoped to the document’s origin and browser profile; private browsing data may be temporary. The game’s exact storage implementation has not been independently inspected for this article, so use the built-in export rather than trying to find or edit files manually.

The game runs at wow.aethus.pl. This independent guide runs on a different domain. Reading this article does not access or contain your game save.

Before You Transfer Your Save

  • Open the exact game address and browser profile where you made the progress.
  • Close private windows and use your regular profile if that is where you usually play.
  • Do not clear site data, cookies, or browser storage until you have exported a backup.
  • Make a separate backup of the destination save if it contains progress you care about.
  • Keep the original export file unchanged. Do not edit it or upload it to a file-sharing site.

Browser storage can differ across site origins, browsers, profiles, and devices. A copied bookmark or a shared game link does not move data by itself.

STEP 1 · ORIGINAL BROWSER

How to Export Your Save

  1. Open the creator’s game website in the browser profile where your progress appears.
  2. Open the game’s Options screen, then find Saves.
  3. Choose Export Save. A current third-party guide says the browser version downloads a save file; save it somewhere you can find again.
  4. Make a second copy in a safe local folder or external drive. Keep one untouched copy until your transfer is confirmed.
  5. Check that the file exists and note which browser, profile, and game address it came from. Do not rename its extension or alter its contents.

The reported menu path is Options → Saves → Export Save. Menu wording may change with game versions. If it differs, follow the current game interface and do not use instructions that ask for your password.

STEP 2 · DESTINATION

How to Import Your Save

  1. Open the intended game address in the destination browser or device.
  2. If the destination already has progress, export it first and keep that backup separately.
  3. Open Options → Saves and choose Import Save if that control is available in the current version.
  4. Select the file you exported from the source browser and confirm only in the game’s own interface.
  5. Return to the game’s save or character screen and confirm the expected progress appears before deleting any backup.

Do not import over a destination save you want to keep. The secondary source consulted for this guide warns that import replaces destination progress. If the current interface shows a different warning or destination behavior, stop and follow the game’s wording.

Moving Between Browsers or Computers

ChangeWhat can be differentSafer action
Same browser, same profilePrivate window or cleared site data can still make a save unavailable.Export a file before clearing browser data; use the same regular profile.
Different browser or profileBrowser site data is usually separate.Export from the source; import into the destination after backing it up.
New computerThe old device’s local data is not automatically on the new one.Move the exported file using a private method you trust, then import through the game.
Windows buildA fan guide reports that the Windows build uses a Saves folder.Use its own export/import controls if available; do not assume its folder format matches browser downloads.

Private or incognito storage may be cleared when its session closes. Treat it as temporary and export progress before closing the last private window. Avoid shared computers and public downloads folders when handling a personal save.

What Happens When You Change Game Websites?

Different addresses can have separate browser storage even if they open the same game. The game itself is hosted on Aethus’s website; this guide domain is not a game host and cannot transfer progress for you. Start by exporting from the exact address where the save is visible, then import at the destination if its current interface supports that action.

A secondary guide reports that progress from an older in-page game address may need a separate “Get your save” export before importing at wow.aethus.pl. This route was not independently verified in the game. If you still have progress on an older address, keep that tab and its data intact while you confirm the current developer instructions.

How to Avoid Overwriting Existing Progress

  • Export both sides before importing: the source save and the destination save.
  • Label backup copies by date, browser/profile, and game address without changing the file itself.
  • Import only after confirming which save the destination currently uses.
  • Keep the source file untouched until the destination has loaded the expected progress.
  • If the game’s warning is unclear, cancel and ask in the creator’s community before trying another file.

There is no cloud save service on this guide site. Never send account passwords or private data to anyone claiming they can recover a save for you.

Troubleshooting Missing or Corrupted Saves

The game starts from the beginning
Check the game address, browser, profile, and whether you are in a private window. Reopen the original environment before clearing any data.
The export file is missing
Check the browser’s download list and chosen download folder. Repeat export only from the original game page if your existing progress still appears.
Import does not appear
Confirm you opened the game’s own Options → Saves area. The menu may change; use the current game UI rather than developer tools.
The imported progress looks wrong
Stop making changes. Preserve the imported file and original backup; do not export over the only copy you have.
A file is rejected
Use an unchanged file exported by the game. Do not edit or repair its contents manually; ask the creator through their current support channel.

For browser and loading issues, see the troubleshooting guide. To learn the controls before restarting, use the first-run walkthrough.

COMMON QUESTIONS

Frequently Asked Questions

Will changing browsers delete my original save?

A new browser may not see data stored by the old one, but that does not necessarily mean the old data was deleted. Return to the original browser and address before exporting or clearing anything.

Can I move progress to another computer?

The reported game flow uses an exported save file. Transfer that file privately, back up any destination progress, then use the game’s import control. Cross-device compatibility has not been independently tested for this guide.

Does import overwrite my current progress?

A recent secondary guide says it replaces destination progress. Export the destination first and preserve that backup before importing.

Can this guide recover my save?

No. This is an informational fan guide; it does not access, upload, store, or restore game saves.

Does the guide website store game data?

No. The game runs on the creator’s site. This page does not request a save file or account credentials.
